definitions.short: properly, to lurk for , i.e. persecute
definitions.full: H7852. satam [ שָׂטַם ] verb bear a grudge, cherish animosity, against (Late Hebrew שָׂטַם Niph`al, ᵑ7 Gen 27:41 שְׂטַם ; perhaps akin to שׂטן q. v.); — Qal Imperfect 3masculine singular וַיִּשְׁטֹם Gen 27:41 , 3 masculine plural suffix יִשְׂטְמוּנִי Psa 55:4 , etc.; — cherish animosity against , accusative of person Gen 27:41 (J), 49:23 (poem in J), 50:15 (E), + בְּאַף Psa 55:4 ; of ׳י 's persistent assaults on Job, Job 16:9 ; 30:21 .

occurrences.englishText: Esau hated Jacob because of the blessing with which his father blessed him. Esau said in his heart, “The days of mourning for my father are at hand. Then I will kill my brother Jacob.”
The archers have severely grieved him,
When Joseph’s brothers saw that their father was dead, they said, “It may be that Joseph will hate us, and will fully pay us back for all the evil which we did to him.”
He has torn me in his wrath and persecuted me.
You have turned to be cruel to me.
My heart is severely pained within me.
